newsitem.title: USA: Assets of U.S. money market funds fell in week.
newsitem.headline: Assets of U.S. money market funds fell in week.

text.p: Total money market mutual fund assets fell in the week ended on Wednesday to $933.67 billion from $940.20 billion the prior week, an industry group said Thursday.
The Investment Company Institute said assets of the nation's 653 retail money market mutual funds rose $2.80 billion to $626.27 billion in the week.

Of the retail funds, assets of the 395 taxable money market funds rose $3.66 billion to $511.24 billion, while assets of the 258 tax-exempt funds fell $860.7 million to $115.03 billion, the group said.

ICI said assets of the 319 institutional money market funds fell $9.33 billion to $307.40 billion. Of these, assets of the 256 taxable money market funds decreased $8.51 billion to $276.60 billion, while assets of the 63 tax-exempt funds fell $815.9 million to $30.81 billion, it said.
ICI revised last week's money market mutual fund assets total to $940.20 billion from $940.14 billion.
